# has accessibility need

Relates an entity to an accessibility facet it requires in order to reach or use a location. Non-functional: needs are co-equal facets (Principle 9). There is no 'primary need' — all asserted needs coexist.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAccessibilityNeed>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hasAccessibilityNeed`  

*object property* · domain `gmeow:Entity` · range `gmeow:AccessibilityFacet`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/accessibility>
